0.10.1 is a patch of 0.10 and interoperates with 0.10.0: format epoch 6, backup format 5 and every storage, wire and protocol format are unchanged. 0.10.0 and 0.10.1 nodes run in one cluster during a rolling upgrade. Upgrade in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`), with no fresh install or data move. Rolling back to 0.10.0 is safe.

- **`/__ursula/usage` reports each bucket's latest snapshot bytes.** Each bucket gains `snapshot_bytes`, the summed body length of its live streams' latest snapshots as uploaded. A 0.10.1 node reports it for every bucket, zero included. The field is optional: a report without it, such as one from a 0.10.0 node, means unknown, not zero, and a sum with an unknown part is unknown. During a rolling upgrade a collector that keeps a 0.10.0 report for a group gets an unknown total for that group's buckets and must not bill it as `0`. A collector built on the 0.10.0 `ursula_proto` reads a 0.10.1 report.
- **`@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` gains `gate(db, work, { signal })`.** It runs `work` and settles with its outcome only once a `synced()` call made after `work` settled resolved on every database given. A returned `Response` keeps its status and headers, and its body passes each chunk on only after a later `synced()` call, one call per batch of chunks. It only calls `synced()`, so it works with any 0.10 extension and server.
- **Rust library APIs.** `ursula_proto::admin::BucketUsageReport` and `ursula_runtime::GroupBucketUsage` gain `snapshot_bytes`, so a struct literal of either needs the field.

This release was published without a DST Nightly run on its commit. The release owner waived it.

Known issues: the known issues of 0.10.0, [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411), [#461](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/461), [#465](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/465), [#496](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/496), [#517](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/517), [#518](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/518), [#561](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/561), [#735](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/735), [#753](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/753), [#754](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/754), [#769](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/769) and [#862](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/862), are unchanged. Every change is listed in the [0.10.1 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#0101).
